##### Project general facts

Azizi Mina by Azizi Developments is a distinctive beachfront residential building whose streamlined form, horizontal balconies and brilliant white finish recall a luxury cruise liner. The building rises from a ground floor and a first floor to nine residential levels, offering one- and two-bedroom apartments and three-bedroom penthouses, many with expansive balconies that open onto panoramic views of the sea, the island and the city skyline.

Residents enjoy a climate-controlled infinity pool, direct access to a private beach with changing cabins, a spa with a jacuzzi and a fully equipped gym. A children's entertainment area, a sun terrace and landscaped gardens add variety, while shops, bars, cafes and restaurants on the ground floor bring everyday convenience to the doorstep. Covered parking, central air conditioning, accessible facilities, a pet-friendly policy and round-the-clock security complete the offer.

Interiors are finished in a refined classic European style, with high ceilings, marble flooring, elegant bathrooms and kitchens with granite countertops and a full range of appliances from international brands. Spacious layouts and large windows fill each home with natural light. Homes are delivered fully furnished, offering a complete, ready-to-move-in residence for owner-occupiers and a turnkey option for investors.

##### Location description and benefits

Palm Jumeirah is the iconic palm-shaped island off the coast of Dubai and one of the most recognisable waterfront addresses in the world. Private beaches, luxury hotels, beach clubs, fine dining and the shops of Nakheel Mall and The Pointe line the island, while the boardwalk and calm residential fronds create a relaxed resort atmosphere throughout the year.

The Palm Monorail and the trunk road connect the island with Sheikh Zayed Road, the Dubai Tram and the metro network. Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence and The Walk are a short drive away, Burj Al Arab and Mall of the Emirates are close by, and Downtown Dubai, The Dubai Mall, Dubai International Airport and Al Maktoum International Airport are within comfortable reach.

Palm Jumeirah is a freehold destination open to international buyers and one of the most prestigious residential markets in Dubai. Ready, fully furnished beachfront homes with private beach access are in limited supply, attracting high-net-worth buyers and holiday-home investors. Strong demand for short-stay rentals and the global appeal of the island underpin premium rental rates and long-term capital value for owners.
